@ffmpeg/ffmpeg 0.12.15 ESM files, unmodified. MIT license in LICENSE.
Source: https://github.com/ffmpegwasm/ffmpeg.wasm
The encoder downloads @ffmpeg/core 0.12.10 ESM from jsDelivr on demand.
ffmpeg-core contains FFmpeg and libx264, distributed under GPL; sources and
build recipes: https://github.com/ffmpegwasm/ffmpeg.wasm/tree/main/packages/core
https://github.com/ffmpegwasm/ffmpeg.wasm/tree/main/build
See https://ffmpegwasm.netlify.app/docs/overview/ for licensing details.
